name: choresync-agent-extension-pack
description: Portable Agent Extension Pack for ChoreSync conforming to the Agent Plugins open standard (agent-plugins.org / AAIF). Bundles chore workflow capabilities, MCP inspection server, specialist personas, guardrail hooks, and least-privilege security policies.

capabilities.name: contract-audit

capabilities.name: db-migration-runner

capabilities.name: cluster-health-prober
capabilities.description: Probes running multi-tier cluster health across Go backend, Caddy reverse proxy, PostgreSQL, and Floci S3/SQS cloud emulator
